messages:
marta: Quick sync — putting together a northstar roadmap for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. Major customer asks queued: region pinning per-tenant, soft eviction for noisy tenants, and policy templates for GDPR customers. Need: prioritization criteria, launch gates, and a rough phasing proposal by EOW.
aj: SGTM. Can we list what 'launch' means here? is it beta for a handful of customers or a full GA with SLA?
marta: Start with gated beta (3–5 customers) then GA when we hit acceptance metrics. Beta should include docs + migration guide.
devon: From infra POV, main tradeoffs: strict isolation increases idle GPU cost; soft-evict needs fast KV cache invalidation. Also region pinning implies per-tenant routing table growth — ops complexity rises.
suresh: Sales note — two enterprise pilots asking for hard region pinning + audit logs. They expect isolation contracts before contract signature. We should prioritize those customers if feasible.
tia: Can we quantify cost / perf delta? even ballpark will help prioritization. e.g., +X% cost for dedicated isolation vs shared.
devon: Ballpark: strict per-tenant slices could be +20–40% infra cost depending on utilization. Soft-eviction + cache TTL tuning could be low single-digit, but adds complexity to rollout.
marta: Good. Let's draft launch gates. Proposal:
```text
Beta launch gates:
- 3 pilot customers onboarded with migration runbook
- Regression: p50/p95 latency within 10% of baseline for common flows
- Eviction safety: no more than 1% request loss during simulated tenant evict
- Observability: token-level cost and per-tenant traces in console
- Security: KMS-backed keys for private deployments
GA launch gates:
- SLA defined (99.95% regional availability for pinned tenants)
- Automated routing-policy templates + CLI / API support
- Pricing model documented (delta vs shared)
- Postmortem runbook for cross-region failovers
```
aj: LGTM. Suggest adding a compatibility matrix for model families (quantized vs fp16) since some routing fallbacks may change execution path.
marta: Good call — add to docs. Also need acceptance tests for function-calling and streaming under pinned routing.
olivia: Legal: customers asking for region pinning + residency will want contractual language. We'll need a template clause for Dedicated vs Private. Also confirm audit log retention limits.
suresh: I'll bring two pilot customers into beta if we can guarantee audit logs + region pinning in a pilot SLA.
tia: Who owns the rollout plan? Recommend Product + Eng-Platform co-own, Eng-Infra implements, Eng-SRE runs phased chaos tests.
aj: I'll take Eng-Platform lead. devon: Infra will build the feature toggles and eviction hooks. SRE will define chaos scenarios.
marta: Action items:
- aj: draft phase plan + owners (due Tue)
- devon: rough cost delta by tenancy model (due Wed)
- olivia: template contractual language + audit retention options (due Thu)
- tia: acceptance test matrix + perf targets (due Thu)
- suresh: identify pilot customers willing to sign pilot SLA (ASAP)
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: routing-feature-flag rollout -> canary 1718830000, monitoring enabled :eyes:
aj: One more thing — we should define non-go criteria e.g., if evict simulation causes >3% error spike or data residency can't be proven for pilot.
marta: Agreed. I'll compile this into a one-pager and circulate. Thanks all — ping me in thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
